signals.summary: A dense wave of from-scratch home bakes — layered mousse cakes, mirror-glazed domes, cinnamon rolls, tarts and puddings — framed as personal pride wins rather than recipes.
signals.why_now: Eleven-plus independent home bakes on Reddit within ~26h: 'Peach black tea cream cheese mousse cake' (1.2h), 'sticky toffee pudding' (2.6h), 'Garbage cake' (6.1h), 'brown butter cinnamon rolls' (6.8h), 'mirror glazed chocolate dome' (7.4h), 'Puff Pastry Tomato Pesto Feta Tarts' (10h), 'finally a cake i feel proud of' (15h) and 'Triple chocolate mousse cake' (16.6h), echoed by a 'Backyard Baking: Latest Culinary Trend' local feature (22.5h).

signals.summary: Small-batch home fermentation — hot sauces, garden-harvest ferments, kombucha/ginger-beer and pickles bubbling in jars and crocks — presented as an ongoing hobby.
signals.why_now: Seven independent r/fermentation posts within ~17h: 'Jimmy Nardellos bubbling away' (2.3h), 'Couple new ferments for next month' (4.8h), 'First ferment!' (5.4h), 'Hot Sauce, my first ferment' (6.6h), 'Fermenting the garden harvest' (11.2h), 'trying out a new pot' (11.8h) and 'Sheng puerh tea in ginger beer' (16.5h).

signals.summary: Portioned weekly meal-prep laid out in matching containers — pasta, mac & cheese, baked oats, Korean and breakfast boxes — shot from above as a grid.
signals.why_now: Five r/MealPrepSunday posts within ~14h: 'Japchae with Chicken! Lunches for two' (5.5h), 'Week 32 of Meal Prep for Weight Loss' (5.6h), 'Meaty Mac & Cheese with broccoli' (9.6h), 'blueberry banana baked oats + breakfast sandwiches' (10.4h) and 'Creamy Red Pepper Chicken Pasta' (13.9h).

signals.summary: Late-summer barbecue and low-and-slow cooking — smoked pulled pork, braised lamb shank, fajitas and neck bones plated with sides — as the seasonal centrepiece.
signals.why_now: Four fresh Reddit posts within ~14h spanning smoke and braise: 'Tweaking my Fajita Method' (0.1h), 'pork neck bones, bacon fried green beans and honey cornbread' (2.9h), 'Summer weekend smoked BBQ pulled pork & coleslaw' (12.8h) and '4 hours on lamb shank' (13.6h).

signals.summary: Home cooks plating Greek and eastern-Mediterranean staples — feta-stuffed chicken, halloumi with roasted veg, souvlaki and pide — bright, herby and photogenic.
signals.why_now: Four independent Mediterranean plates within ~10h: 'Spinach feta stuffed Greek chicken' (3.1h), 'pide' (7.5h), 'Pork Souvlaki, marinated to perfection' (7.9h) and 'Halloumi, Greek style roasted veg... tzatziki and flatbread' (9.2h).
